sources.title: Aurora Foundation: official scholarship page
sources.text:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE SOURCE: written for the Blunder Check demo. The Aurora Foundation and this scholarship are fictional.

Aurora Foundation: Aurora Merit Scholarship 2026-27
Last updated: 12 August 2026

About the scholarship
The Aurora Merit Scholarship supports undergraduate students from low-income families who have performed well in school. The award is Rs. 50,000 per academic year, paid directly to the student's bank account.

Eligibility
Applicants must have scored at least 85% in Class XII. The annual family income must be below Rs. 6,00,000. Applicants must be 22 years of age or younger on 1 September 2026.

Documents required
Applicants must upload the following documents: income certificate issued by the Tehsildar, Class XII marksheet, a copy of the bank passbook, and one passport-size photograph.

Important dates
The last date to submit applications is 15 November 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email.

How to apply
Applications are accepted only through the online portal linked on this page. Offline applications will not be considered.

Contact
For queries, write to scholarships@aurorafoundation.example.

sources.text:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE SOURCE: written for the Blunder Check demo. Riverbend University and the Aurora Foundation are fictional.

Riverbend University: Student Affairs Blog
Posted: 3 September 2026

Scholarships to watch this season: Aurora Merit Scholarship

Here is what you need to know if you plan to apply for the Aurora Merit Scholarship this year.

Documents to keep ready: income certificate or ITR acknowledgement, Class XII marksheet, bank passbook, and a caste certificate if applicable.

Deadline: Our office has noted that applications close on 30 November 2026, so there is still plenty of time.

The award is Rs. 50,000 per year. The scholarship may be renewed in later years, but students should check with the foundation for the renewal conditions.

Students who need help with the application can visit the Student Affairs office on the second floor.

Aurora Foundation
Notice No. AMS/2026/07
Date: 10 October 2026

Subject: Aurora Merit Scholarship 2026-27: Clarifications and extension of last date

1. The income certificate must have been issued within the last six months before the date of application. ITR acknowledgements are not accepted as proof of income.

2. The last date to submit applications has been extended to 22 November 2026.

3. Applicants who have already submitted an application need not re-apply.

Issued by the Scholarship Cell, Aurora Foundation.
